steps.text: Hm.
Now what?
To recap, I was kicked out of my home.
Then, the new place I was sent to live is filled with girls.
What's more, not only are they pretty, they're scary....
...I really have no idea how things got to this point.
For now, I should do something...
Maybe I'll do as she said and take a look around?
As soon as I think that, I hear the familiar beep of the front door.
Huh? Who could that be?
Hehe~
Huh? What are you doing standing around in the middle of the room?
Uh? No, I'm just...
I was talking to Saeun, and she just left to go sleep.
Oh, really? Saeun doesn't usually talk to strangers!
Guess you'll be friends in no time, then. That's good!
Uh, sure.
I have my doubts about that...
Why'd you come back, though?
Hm? Ah~ That's because...
I got the date wrong... Hehe~
How many brain cells does she have?
I hope she didn't lose anything while she was out.
Oh! I forgot to buy eggs!
Uweh...
Do we have any in the fridge...?
Oh, we do! Four even~ Thank goodness.
Have you eaten? You haven't, right? I'm gonna make myself some kimchi fried rice. Want any?
Uh, sure.
Come to think of it, I haven't eaten at all today since I rushed to get here early in the morning.
That being said... Can I really trust anything that she makes?
Kimchi~ Kimchi fried rice~
My delicious kimchi fried rice~♫
Wow... She's really on another level...
Has she had a couple of drinks, maybe?
Hm? What's up?
N-no, it's nothing. I'm looking forward to it.
Mhmmhmm~
Well... It's not like there's anything wrong with being optimistic, right?
Okay... First up, the egg—
Whoops!
Splat.
Ahaha... It's okay, we have more...
Will it really be safe to eat this?
Mmhm~ What do I put in first?
The kimchi and...
Oh! Eggs!
Where did I put the bowl...?
Huh?
It clatters to the floor with a loud clang.
...It hasn't even been 5 minutes since the last slip.
I hope this kitchen is left standing by the end of this dish.
Um... Are you alright?
Oh! The fried rice is totally fine, so don't worry about it!!!
I'm more worried about you than the food...
Though actually, maybe I should worry about the fried rice too...
Or maybe, I should start with myself...?
Oh actually, can you come over here for a sec?
Sure, what's up?
Here, try this!
Urk!
How is it? Does it taste good?
Ugh, it's salty...
How about the bacon? Is it cooked properly?
Mm, it is crispy...
Really! Then my turn~
Nom...
Bleh! It's salty!
Still, nothing beats stealing a bite while cooking~
Don't you think?
I wouldn't know as someone who's never cooked before, but...
Yeah, maybe.
Today has gone pretty smoothly so far, so just hang on tight for just a bit!
Today...? Then what about the other days...
I'm finally doooone~!
Somehow, she really did complete the meal.
Can something birthed by that process really be safe to eat?
It looks okay... It smells okay...
Whaddya think? It looks good, doesn't it!?
Even picky Saeun gobbles this right up.
Saeun eats this?
...Maybe it really will be fine, then.
*munch*
*munch munch munch*
This is actually pretty good...?!
It's tasty, isn't it? I'm actually a pretty good cook, see!
A bite for me too~
Nom! It's sooooo good ♥
Ehehe...
She's enjoying it.
It tastes so much better than what I had feared...
Actually, how could that process even lead to this?
Do the other two not mind the mess she makes?
Oh, right, so, what were you chatting with Saeun about earlier?
Huh? Why?
I was just wondering if Saeun properly explained stuff~
Uh, that's...
Use my common sense and clean up after myself, or something.
Actually, I don't think she properly explained anything to me at all.
Just that I should keep things clean, I guess?
Aha! Then she didn't, did she?
Um, it's not like that...
...Though it is.
I knew it. Then I'll take this opportunity to explain things to you!
You know where your room is?
Oh, I did get that much.
Okay, then... We get together to do a big cleanup of the house occasionally, and..
We split utilities like electricity and gas by usage.
Then, um...
Uhh... I forgot!
We can just figure things out as we go~
Rather, about Yunha and Saeun~
Mhm~ They're so much fun once you get to know them!
...That's it?
You'll see what I mean.
Saeun is cuter than you'd think, and Yunha is really funny... Fufu...
I guess that's about it?
Do you think you got everything?
Uh... Yeah.
I don't think it was actually very helpful, but...
And if you have any other questi—
Her sentence is interrupted by the loud ringing of her cellphone.
Huh? Who's calling me?
Hello?
Oi, Jihye! Where are you?
Me? I'm home, why?
What? You're still at home?
We agreed to meet up today!
Huh? Wasn't that Tuesday?
Uh... Today is Tuesday...
Ack! Oh no!
I'm sorry but I gotta go bye!
If you have any questions just ask any of us!
Uh, sure...
Then, adiós!
...And there she goes.
Now what?
Oh, I should do the dishes..
I want to go home...
I can't sleep.
Maybe it's because of all of the energy drinks I've been having...
...But either way, I can't sleep.
I've already finished all my dailies for today...
Played some games...
...I should study....
...But it's so late, so I'll do it tomorrow!
To do that, I need to sleep... But I can't sleep.
...Maybe I'll go get a drink from the fridge outside.
I open my bedroom door gently, but it still creaks as it opens.
Oh.
Huh?
What you looking at.
Nothing? I just could'nt sleep.
Oh. I see.
Why are you awake?
Well... I'm usually awake this time.
I guess... you probably didn't sleep because you were playing games, right?
Playing games all day... and now it's late, maybe I should start tomorrow!
Oh, but I can't sleep! Maybe I should go get something to drink... Right?
Can she read minds?
Let's test it...
Dumb girl. Idiot. Try read this sucker.
Huh?
Shit. You heard that?
Heard what? I asked you a question.
I mean... You're right.
Come on. If I were you I would atleast study for a bit.
Sorry...
Then come over to my room and study. I'm sleepy too.
Anyway you can't sleep right?
Yea... plus, wake me up when I fall asleep.
Alright... I'll go grab my books.
Sure, whenever you feel like coming. I'll be in my room.
Just a few textbook should be enough...
...But does Saeun seriously not mind?
We're not that close, and I am technically going into a girl's room...
Or maybe she's just not really thinking about stuff like that.
Books ready, I open her bedroom door.
That took you forever.
It's not your first time here, so relax.
Okay.
Don't just stand there awkwardly. Let's see...
Go bring a chair from your own room. You can work next to me.
Oh, that's a good idea.
I obediently listen to her words and bring a chair over.
You're studying for the university admission exams, right?
Even though I didn't end up going to uni, I did take the test so feel free to ask me any questions.
Huh? You took the exams? But you didn't go to...
Yeah. This seemed like a more productive use of my time.
It didn't really feel like there was much to learn there, either.
But you could meet friends, and...
Friends? What friends? They're just a waste of time. I don't have friends.
Then what about me?
You... You're...
Maybe like a background character?
...I'll just study.
I open up my textbooks.
Saeun's desk is quite large and there's plenty of room for them.
Wait, what are you doing?!
Huh? I'm studying...
No, no. I think you got the wrong book?
...Huh? Is there a problem with my history book...?
I don't think so...?
Why are you studying history?
Are you confident in all of your other subjects?
Your core subjects? Literature, English, Math?
But history is fun...
*sigh* Do you even watch online lectures?
Uh... I watch whatever pops up on UTube...
...Where do I even begin...?
I think the UTube lectures are pretty good...
... Are you planning on flunking this year too?
At this rate, there's no way you'll be able to get into university.
You're already disadvantaged with your level of intelligence, if you're being this inefficient...
If you're going to watch Utube videos anyway, you should find some study strategy videos from actual educators and study channels.
Seriously, just watching you makes me feel frustrated... How are you going to even get in like this, let alone make friends there...?
Sorry...
I know I've been slacking, but hearing her words makes me finally come to my senses.
I note down her words in the corner of my notebook.
Hahh... It's going to be tough to catch up at this point...
You really can't afford to play games now. Even now I'm not sure if you'll get above a C...
What did you get?
A, A, A, A+, A+.
Woah... You could've had your pick of uni with grades like that, right?
I mean, yeah, but I don't really have any regrets.
I would've gone if I were you...
Then how about you study, get the same grades as me, and then go? Say 'yes ma'am' if you understand.
Yes ma'am...
Good. Now, let me take a look...
How confident are you with math?
Um... I basically gave up after middle school.
...Ugh. Okay, there are some lectures that cover everything from the elementary level.
You should start there and master the basics first.
I think getting an A might be impossible, but... You should at least aim to get a B.
I mean, you do want to go to a uni. Right?
Seriously, you need to get it together.
Sorry...
As for literature, there's a huge difference in how you have to approach fiction and non-fiction, so you really need to read a lot of both.
Depending on which lecturer you choose to study from, the way you take in and organize info will vary a ton too.
All the different courses set different paces for their lessons too, so it's always better to get started earlier.
You're not at the point where it's completely hopeless yet.
Thanks.
My heart feels warm at Saeun's genuine concern for me.
Hehe.
I'll do my best.
Honestly, you can completely put history aside until a month before the actual exam.
But history is fun...
Then you do that and fail the rest. It's up to you.
Sorry...
Stop apologizing to me!!!
If you're that sorry, then change your behaviour!
I have a ton on my plate too, you know?
I'll do my best on my own...
Give me your phone.
Huh...? Why?
I don't want to hand it over...
I'll be arrested if she checks my search history.
Come on, I promise not to dig around so hurry up!
O-okay...
She starts tapping away on my phone.
Then she pulls up playlists and playlists of videos that cover the scope for university admission exams.
For starters, watch these and figure out a basic plan of attack.
Considering you did go to school, you should at least know what subjects you're good at. Right?
R-right...
I guess that's literature since I can at least read Korean...
So watch them, and think about it for a little bit.
Seriously, how did you get this far in life like this?
Since I don't trust you to do things properly, I want you to come study in my room from now on.
Can I ask you questions if I need help?
Only if you try figuring it out on your own first. I don't want to end up answering stuff like basic addition.
You're not going to tell me that you don't know basic addition, right?
No, no, I'm good there.
Get to it, then. I'm working on a job, so don't disturb me until I'm done.
O-okay, understood...
Saeun begins to focus on her work.
The room is silent, except for the sound of Saeun playing her keyboard.
As for my studies... I've never approached it this systematically before.
I used to just try and cram everything into my head.
...Whenever I did study, which wasn't often because I spent most of my time playing games.
Oh man, I really want to play again. I used to be so good at headshots...
Bleh... I really wonder if I'll be okay.
Stop getting distracted and get back to figuring out your study plans.
This is exactly why you've ended up wasting all this time.
Yeah... Sorry.
...Ugh, fine. Look here.
She snatches my pen from me and opens up my notebook.
Basically, on this side you write the keywords and ideas, while the actual notes are on the other. This is called the Cornell note-taking system.
Maybe she feels bad for being so hard on me? She starts showing me how I should organize my notes.
Has anyone ever taken the time to teach me something so carefully?
I know she has better things to do, and I feel both grateful but also happy, as if I've made a friend.
Hello? You listening?
Yeah... I just... Why are you teaching me all this?
It's not really anything big. I just wish I had someone to point me in the right direction when I found what I wanted to do.
I can understand why you're like this. It's because you didn't know better, and no one told you anything either.
But even still, the fact that you're even trying counts for a lot. I know it's hard.
Though I'm not sure if she's actually complimenting me or somehow insulting me, her words strike a chord in me and I feel almost like crying. It's nice, and that means something.
Anyway, please pay attention. I don't like to repeat myself.
And so, I studied hard through the night with Saeun.
